response.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS project_count FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), t AS (SELECT archstat, project_count, project_count * 1.0 / SUM(project_count) OVER () AS share FROM s), u AS (SELECT archstat, project_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM t) SELECT archstat, project_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_above_average FROM u WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY share DESC

assumptions.assumption: A missing status means archstat IS NULL. GROUP BY puts all NULLs in one group, which is reported as its own status row with a NULL archstat. Empty strings are treated as ordinary distinct values.

The share denominator is the sum of the per-status distinct-project counts, as the request says. A project with QC records under several statuses is counted in each, so the denominator can exceed the number of distinct projects.
The average share is the unweighted mean of the per-status shares, which equals 1 divided by the number of status groups. The amount above average is share minus that mean, with no rounding.
